attchmntText: B&B Triplewall Containers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Arjun R. Khati as Senior Management Personnel of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: B&B Triplewall Containers Limited has appointed Ms. Sushmita Subhash Kannojiya as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective November 14, 2026. The Board of Directors approved this appointment on November 14, 2026, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Ms. Kannojiya holds membership number A79491 with the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. The company also appointed Mr. Arjun R. Khati as Senior Management Personnel, effective November 14, 2026. Mr. Khati previously served as General Manager Unit-1. These changes were disclosed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The intimation has been hosted on the company website.

attchmntText: B&B Triplewall Containers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding '' Appointment of Ms. Sushmita Subhash Kannojiya ( M. No. A79491) as a Company Secretary & Compliance Officer ( KMP) of the Company w.e.f. November 14, 2026."
voiceSummary: B&B Triplewall Containers Limited appointed Ms. Sushmita Subhash Kannojiya as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 14, 2026. The Board of Directors approved this appointment on November 14, 2026, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Ms. Kannojiya holds membership number A79491 with the Institute of the Company Secretaries of India. She is a Commerce graduate from the University of Mumbai and is pursuing an LLB from the same university. Prior to this role, she served as Company Secretary and Junior Associate at Suyog Telematics Limited and as Assistant Company Secretary at HCAPS Investech Private Limited. The appointment is subject to terms and conditions approved by the Board. This intimation has been filed with the stock exchanges and hosted on the company website.

attchmntText: B&B Triplewall Containers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: B&B Triplewall Containers Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Ms. Sushmita Subhash Kannojiya as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective November 14, 2026. Mr. Arjun R. Khati was appointed as Senior Management Personnel, effective November 14, 2026. The Board Meeting was held on November 14, 2026. The meeting commenced at 02:30 p.m. and concluded at 05:00 p.m. Independent auditors Surana Naveen Vikash & Co reviewed the standalone and consolidated financial statements. The auditors reported no material misstatements in the financial results. The intimation was filed under SEBI Listing Regulations.
